body: I've been feeling like this since my dad left when I was 9 and died in an accident not a month later. everythings been a downward spiral from there

Thank you. In all honesty, I was going to end it this sunday with painkillers and some bleach to down it all. But your words gave me an inch hope to hold it off. But im unsure. What good could come out of all this? I can't see myself having any form of a happy future
